auth.instructions: From the installed stack directory, configure a dedicated public-client Entra application and explicit named accounts in ~/.rudi/state/stacks/microsoft-365/config.json (or RUDI_HOME/state/stacks/microsoft-365/config.json). Grant only delegated User.Read and Mail.Read; device sign-in requests offline_access and standard MSAL sign-in scopes. Run npm run auth -- account-alias and finish the displayed Microsoft device sign-in from any browser, including a phone. The CLI verifies the configured tenant and mailbox before saving the per-account private token cache. See README.md for exact setup, storage limitations and read-only smoke commands.

meta.description: Explicit-account, delegated read-only Outlook mail and attachment access through Microsoft Graph v1.0.
